g.text: do / the Planner or a Maintainer writes the issue
do / cumin waits for a free slot
do / GitHub runs the required checks
do / the Reviewer reviews the pull request
do / a Maintainer reviews the pull request
do / cumin merges the pull request,
copy the labels to the pull request: in every state, the labels of the issue differ from
those of its pull request / cumin copies the labels.
write the follow-up note: the issue is closed and its pull request is merged
[a Maintainer added ready, the blockers are closed,
/ cumin requests a check fix from the Implementer
[no Implementer runs, cumin could not verify
[no Implementer runs, and: the Implementer asked
a question, cumin could not verify the pull request
the second time, or a conflict resolution left the head commit]
/ cumin requests the review from the Reviewer
[no Reviewer runs, and: the head commit moved,
or a required check does not pass]
[a required check failed, the fix requests
[a required check gave no result in time]
[no Reviewer runs, the Reviewer requested changes
on the head commit, the rounds are under the limit]
/ cumin requests a review fix from the Implementer
[no Reviewer runs, the Reviewer approved the
head commit, the checks passed, risk/low]
[no Reviewer runs, the Reviewer approved the
/ cumin requests the Issue Owner's review
[no Reviewer runs, the Reviewer requested changes,
the rounds are at the limit, no explanation yet]
/ cumin requests the cause from the Reviewer
[no Reviewer runs, the Reviewer left no review
on the head commit, first time]
[the Reviewer wrote the explanation of the cause]
[no Reviewer runs, and: the Reviewer asked a question,
or the Reviewer left no review the second time]
/ cumin requests a response from the Implementer
[GitHub shows the pull request as merged]
[the pull request is not merged, the approval
or the checks no longer hold]
A box is a state: a label on GitHub, without "cumin/status/". "do /" says who works in the state.
An arrow is a transition: [guard] / effect, each with its actor. The first line is the name of the transition in issue-states.md.
Every guard reads only facts on GitHub and "no agent runs for this issue".
